title: APO Rosemary Sirloin Roast for Two Donenesses
description: A lean sirloin roast supplies rosy center slices and a second, more-done portion warmed gently in rosemary-mustard gravy.
equipment: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with food probe, bottom drip pan and middle wire rack

ingredients.name: lean intact boneless top sirloin roast
ingredients.note: Fully thawed whole muscle, no more than 2 inches thick; no injections, stuffing, rolling or mechanical tenderizing. Trim exterior fat and silver skin.

ingredients.name: low-sodium beef broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made from meat, bones and water without a vegetable seasoning blend.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Fill the water tank and install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 133°F with sous vide mode on, 100% steam, rear element on, top and bottom elements off. Set the food probe target to 132°F.

steps.title: Probe the intact roast
steps.text: Place {beef} unbagged on the middle wire rack with the solid pan one level below. Insert an accurate food probe into the geometric center of the thickest section.

steps.title: Heat the center
steps.text: Cook at 133°F with 100% steam until the center reaches 132°F. Allow roughly 1 1/2–3 hours depending on shape. Confirm the coldest central spot reads at least 132°F with the instant-read thermometer and leave the probe there.

steps.title: Hold the core temperature
steps.text: Use a manual continuous cooking stage at 133°F, sous vide mode on, 100% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Leave the probe in place to monitor the core. Start a separate 90-minute timer only after the center check. Monitor the coldest point and keep it at or above 131°F for all 90 minutes. If it falls below 131°F, return the center to 132°F and restart the full hold.

steps.title: Infuse the rosemary
steps.text: During the final 15 minutes of the hold, simmer {broth}, {rosemary} and {garlic} in the HexClad, covered, for 6 minutes. Remove the rosemary sprig.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and keep it bubbling gently for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Carve after the hold
steps.text: Once the full hold is complete, slice the beef thinly across the grain. Plate the rosy portions with warm gravy.

steps.title: Finish the more-done portions
steps.text: Keep the remaining slices submerged in the gravy over low heat, just below a simmer. Check from 1 minute and lift each serving when its center reaches 145°F. Rest these slices covered for 3 minutes, then serve with extra gravy.

notes: Make ahead: Infuse the broth the day before. Keep the roast whole until the humid hold is complete. Use the low-temperature method only with the specified intact roast, a reliable probe and uninterrupted full steam. If you cannot verify the hold or humidity, finish the whole roast covered at 325°F, sous vide mode off, 80% steam, rear on, top and bottom off, probe target 145°F; then rest at least 3 minutes before carving. The timed hold is based on the FDA Food Code whole-roast table in section 3-401.11(B). For a gentler gravy, leave out the mustard. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze thin slices submerged in gravy for up to 6 weeks; reheating to 165°F changes their doneness. Fridge reheat: Place one portion and its sauce in a shallow covered dish. Install the APO bottom drip pan and preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Insert the probe in the coldest center and set it to 165°F. Start checking after 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw a single portion in the refrigerator overnight, then use the fridge reheating method. Stir the sauce until smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 213 kcal, 33.3 g protein, 3.8 g total carbohydrate, 6.0 g fat, 0.1 g fiber, 106 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
preferredMethod: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with food probe, bottom drip pan and middle wire rack

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Preheat Samsung Bake to 325°F; choose a snug lidded roasting dish.

steps.title: Roast the sirloin
steps.text: Place {beef} in the dish with a shallow layer of water, cover and roast for 35–75 minutes according to thickness. Check from 30 minutes. Roast to 145°F in the center and rest covered for at least 3 minutes.

steps.title: Infuse the rosemary
steps.text: simmer {broth}, {rosemary} and {garlic} in the HexClad, covered, for 6 minutes. Remove the rosemary sprig.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and keep it bubbling gently for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.text: Slice thinly across the grain and spoon the mustard gravy over each portion.
